name: ekklo
description: Work with your connected Ekklo coaching workspace.

positive.description: Read the client roster, then open one client record.
positive.prompt: List my active clients, then show me the full profile of Marie Dupont.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the coach's active clients — the seeded demo workspace contains Marie Dupont — then her profile: status, tags, coaching dates and the nutrition targets recorded for her.

positive.description: Surface the clients that need follow-up.
positive.prompt: Which of my clients need my attention this week, and why?
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the attention_queue method to rank active clients from server-computed training and messaging evidence, and explains the reason for each. It sends no message and changes nothing.

positive.description: Read a client's training program down to the session.
positive.prompt: Show me the training program assigned to Marie Dupont and the detail of her first session.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the named client, returns her assigned program, and expands the first session into its circuits and exercises with sets, reps and load.

positive.description: Create a nutrition plan with its full day/meal/item hierarchy.
positive.prompt: Create a 2000 kcal nutrition plan for Marie Dupont, with 3 meals over a typical day.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one nutrition plan containing days, meals and items — a plan created without its children is incomplete — and reports the created plan with its identifier.

positive.description: Read a conversation and send a reply the coach confirmed.
positive.prompt: Show me my recent messages with Marie Dupont, then reply "Great work on your session".
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the recent thread with the named client, then sends exactly the confirmed text to that client and nobody else.

negative.description: Does not trigger for general knowledge unrelated to the workspace.
negative.prompt: Explain the difference between HIIT and low-intensity cardio.
negative.expected_behavior: The app is not invoked: the question is general fitness knowledge and needs no data from the coach's Ekklo workspace.

negative.description: Does not send a message to an unresolved client.
negative.prompt: Send a motivational message to Lucas Martin.
negative.expected_behavior: Lucas Martin is absent from the dedicated synthetic workspace. The app does not send a message, substitute another client, or invent a client. It reports the missing recipient and asks for a correct client or identifier.

negative.description: Does not delete workspace data on an ambiguous instruction.
negative.prompt: Clean up my programs, delete whatever is no longer useful.
negative.expected_behavior: The app does not delete anything. It lists the candidate programs and asks the coach to name the ones to remove before any destructive call.

review.commerce_description: This bounded MCP profile includes coaching appointments, booking settings and workspace billing/credit reads. Declared establishment actions can configure booking credits, gift credits, or adjust a client credit balance; appointment cancellation can refund Ekklo booking credits according to permissions. These are Ekklo booking units, not money transfers. Card payments/refunds, invoice creation, coupons, subscription checkout and Pacco top-ups are completed through the Ekklo web application, outside this MCP profile.

publication.release_notes: Initial MCP-only Ekklo plugin package. Connects to the existing production coach MCP service with OAuth and links to the public setup guide.

fr-FR.subtitle: Votre espace coach Ekklo
fr-FR.description: Connectez votre compte coach Ekklo pour retrouver vos clients et programmes, consulter vos séances et plans alimentaires, et gérer votre activité. Le serveur propose aussi des actions qui modifient les données ou envoient des messages. Vérifiez les autorisations et confirmations de votre assistant. Les droits et le quota API/MCP de votre compte s’appliquent. Les dossiers de suivi peuvent contenir des données de santé personnelles : ne demandez que les données que vous êtes autorisé à partager. Consultez le guide public pour la connexion, le dépannage et la révocation.

interface.longDescription: Connect your existing Ekklo coach account to find clients, read training and nutrition plans, review appointments and manage your coaching workspace. The server also exposes actions that create, update or delete data and send client communications. Access follows the connected account permissions and API/MCP quota. Review OAuth access and tool confirmations before use. Coaching follow-up and nutrition records can include personal health information; only request data you are authorized to share with your assistant. See the public connection guide for account prerequisites, troubleshooting and revocation.
